name: How do you make a drywall patch match the existing wall texture?
description: Matching texture involves identifying the specific finish, testing spray or trowel techniques on scrap board, and feathering the edges into the surrounding wall

mainEntity.name: How do you make a drywall patch match the existing wall texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching existing texture requires identifying whether your wall has orange peel, knockdown, skip trowel, or a smooth finish, and testing application methods beforehand. Texture consistency is altered by adjusting compound thickness, spray pressure, or trowel angle. Before applying texture to your wall, a technician will typically test the pattern on a scrap piece of cardboard to match the density and droplet size of the surrounding surface. Feathering the edges outward beyond the patched area prevents a visible raised ridge around the repair.
